notes.title: Achievements!
notes.notes:
Great news for all players!

- Now you can gain the [url=steamcommunity.com/stats/558490/achievements]Achievements[/url] while playing our game!!!
- Also we have added new languages: Francais, Espanol, Italiano, Nederlands, Português
- Problem with game savings is fixed now!

Have a good game!
